import pandas as pd
from io import StringIO

catalog = pd.read_csv(CATALOG_CSV)
catalog.set_index('timeseries_id', inplace=True)

with open(GRAPH_TTL) as f:
    graph_ttl = f.read()

# Parse the query results from the string within the TTL file
start_str = 'START'
end_str = 'END'
start_idx = graph_ttl.find(start_str)
end_idx = graph_ttl.find(end_str)

if start_idx == -1 or end_idx == -1:
    raise ValueError('Could not find query results in the provided TTL data.')

query_results_str = graph_ttl[start_idx + len(start_str):end_idx]
query_results = pd.read_json(StringIO(query_results_str))

# Assuming there will be one result for the query, extract series IDs
temp_series_id = query_results['?tempSeries'][0].split('/')[-1]
heat_setpoint_series_id = query_results['?heatSetpointSeries'][0].split('/')[-1]
cool_setpoint_series_id = query_results['?coolSetpointSeries'][0].split('/')[-1]


# Verify each series ID matches the expected point in the catalog
temp_series_id = catalog.loc[catalog['point_uri'] == f'http://example.com/sensors/{temp_series_id}', 'timeseries_id'].values[0]
heat_setpoint_series_id = catalog.loc[catalog['point_uri'] == f'http://example.com/sensors/{heat_setpoint_series_id}', 'timeseries_id'].values[0]
cool_setpoint_series_id = catalog.loc[catalog['point_uri'] == f'http://example.com/sensors/{cool_setpoint_series_id}', 'timeseries_id'].values[0]

values_df = pd.read_csv(VALUES_CSV)

# Extract values for the specified date
date = '2018-01-06'
temp_values = values_df[values_df['timeseries_id'] == temp_series_id]
temp_values = temp_values[temp_values['timestamp'].str.startswith(date)]
heat_values = values_df[values_df['timeseries_id'] == heat_setpoint_series_id]
heat_values = heat_values[heat_values['timestamp'].str.startswith(date)]
cool_values = values_df[values_df['timeseries_id'] == cool_setpoint_series_id]
cool_values = cool_values[cool_values['timestamp'].str.startswith(date)]

# Ensure the timestamp columns are aligned
temp_values.set_index('timestamp', inplace=True)
heat_values.set_index('timestamp', inplace=True)
cool_values.set_index('timestamp', inplace=True)

# Merge the DataFrames on the timestamp
temp_heat = pd.merge(temp_values, heat_values, left_index=True, right_index=True, suffixes=("_temp", "_heat"))
all_values = pd.merge(temp_heat, cool_values, left_index=True, right_index=True, suffixes=("_temp", "_cool"))

# Calculate the count of values outside the setpoint band
outside_band_count = ((all_values['value_temp'] < all_values['value_heat']) | (all_values['value_temp'] > all_values['value_cool'])).sum()

print(outside_band_count)
